01 / The new vision

Your art deserves more.

An opening lasts an evening. An artist's journey lasts much longer. We replace the isolated event with an active, year-long relationship: someone to exchange ideas with, create with and turn to when new possibilities arise.

04 / Your freedom

Create when you want.

New work today, a triptych tomorrow, several new ideas in the same week: your Art Curator helps you shape a flexible, continuous presence around your own creative needs.

Your art is alive.Your presence should be too.

  • One year at a time
  • No obligation to renew
  • No sales commission

2029

05 / The grand finale

A digital journey.A physical finale.

The Triennale culminates in a major international physical event in 2029. Participation in the Grand Finale is included even if you join for only one annual programme.

06 / The artist advisory project

More than a gallery.A team by your side.

A new international artist advisory project: personal curatorial dialogue, professional representation, your own digital space, continuous MADSVERSE presence, editorial communication and opportunities to connect beyond our gallery.
